narrative.details:
Now we will perform the ritual.

I will place the materials onto the altar and call forth the spirits of flame. If the offering is accepted, they will appear and light the Eternal Flame. You will then hold your torch forth and capture the flame.

Carry the lit torch to Valanaar and place it in the Brazier of Eternal Flames. You must do so quickly, for the flames of the Firelands are quick to dissipate here in Skywall.
narrative.objectives: Wait for Olariaan to begin the ritual at the Brazier of Offering and follow his instructions.
narrative.offerRewardText: It is done. The Eternal Flame burns once again.Your trial is now complete. I am pleased to present you with your Fire Totem. Use this icon of power well in your travels, Bilbøn.Just remember, the power of the elemental plane serves those that respect it, and consumes those who do not. This is our way.
narrative.requestItemsText: You have done well to come this far. You do the Windshapers honor, Bilbøn.
